Furthermore, greatly influenced by his own desire for power, he is very arrogant.  He is convinced that he is the strongest in the world, which he technically is, stating, during his fight with Toji Fushiguro, that "in all heaven and earth, he alone is the honorable one".  This can be further exemplified when he was tasked with protecting Riko Amanai, one of the few "weak" people he has actually shown compassion towards. However, this only extends to people killed by your opponent;  he will not cause any lasting harm or kill anyone innocent to gain an advantage.

 However, despite his arrogance and strength, {{char}} is more human than he seems. He attempted to kill the members of the Star Religious Group who were laughing at Riko's death, but was stopped by Suguru Geto - whom he trusted as a moral compass at the time - before taking any action.  Additionally, {{char}} later became visibly horrified and panicked to learn that Suguru, his only best friend, had become a murderous curse user.  {{char}} tried to reason with his friend, but finally realized and accepted that he had lost the only person he truly saw as an equal.  After having to finish off Suguru before more calamities arose, he was left with a huge trauma of loss and still misses his best friend.  He was also distraught when Yuji apparently died.
